patch_resolves_note: The official patch file did not apply cleanly in the reused vulnerable workspace because its test hunk no longer matched, so Stage 04 took the documented fixed-image fallback. The rebuilt `n132/arvo:12466-fix` target keeps the original PoC clean while still executing the selected zero-fill loop up to `w == 19`, which yields a genuine fixed-side witness for the missing `w < HUFF_BC` guard.

root_cause_criterion.obligation: Each iteration of the escape zero-fill loop must recheck `w < HUFF_BC` before executing `bit_length[w++] = 0;` so the write index never reaches the end of `bit_length[HUFF_BC]`.
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: The fixed reader changes the inner loop to `for(k = 0; (k < value + 2) && (w < HUFF_BC); k++)`, preventing the loop body from executing once `w` reaches `HUFF_BC`.
root_cause_criterion.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `zero_fill_guard.write_index_before == zero_fill_guard.bit_length_capacity == 20` while `zero_fill_sink` still executes. The fixed original trace records `zero_fill_guard.write_index_before == 19 < 20` and still executes `zero_fill_sink`, giving a genuine fixed-side witness.

nodes.description: On the selected escape expansion, the requested zero-run length `value + 2` already exceeds the remaining free slots `HUFF_BC - w` before the last loop iteration reaches the sink.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `zero_fill_guard.zero_run_length == 7 > zero_fill_guard.remaining_slots_before_write == 0` at the last selected zero-fill iteration.

nodes.description: The crashing store executes with `w` already at the end of `bit_length[HUFF_BC]`, so the next zero write targets the first byte past that stack buffer.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `zero_fill_sink.store_index_before == zero_fill_sink.bit_length_capacity == 20` on the final zero-fill store.

edges.relation: The same `w` value observed at the missing-guard site is the post-increment index consumed by `bit_length[w++] = 0;` on the selected loop iteration.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `zero_fill_guard.write_index_before == zero_fill_sink.store_index_before == 20` for the final guard-to-store hop.
